result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but one clear visual defect stands out: a loading spinner is overlaid on top of an already-rendered restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section, making the card look stuck in a loading state. Other apparent cut-offs (carousel edge item, bottom card) are expected scroll behavior and are excluded.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' shows a circular loading spinner centered over the fully loaded food image. The image is already rendered, so the persistent spinner indicates a stuck/incorrect loading state and obscures the photo.
issues.suggestion: Remove the spinner once the image has loaded (tie the loader to actual image load state, with a timeout/fallback). Show the spinner only as a placeholder before the image is available, and ensure error states display a fallback image rather than an endless spinner.

issues.description: Cards in 'Fastest near you' show only name and delivery fee, while 'Popular right now' cards include rating, time, and cuisine. The inconsistency makes the top carousel feel sparse and less informative by comparison.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding a rating or cuisine tag to the 'Fastest near you' cards for consistent information density across sections.
